name: Jackknife
summary: From a Roll Over, the legs shoot up to the ceiling so the body balances straight on the shoulders, then the spine rolls down slowly.
steps: Lie on the back, arms pressing down, legs long.
Breathe in to lift the legs over the head, level with the floor.
Breathe out to send the legs straight up, hips over shoulders.
Breathe in to roll down bone by bone, legs staying over the face as long as possible.

layers.title: Roll over and lower
layers.text: Legs parallel to the floor, then roll down.

layers.title: Lift to vertical
layers.text: Legs shoot up over the shoulders.

layers.title: Slow roll down
layers.text: Legs stay vertical as long as they can while the spine comes down.

cautions.note: Check the shoulders tolerate the load.

cues:
Weight on the shoulders and arms, never the neck.
Squeeze the seat to stand the legs up.
The roll down is the slow part.
